svg.title: Choose the value, then add the padding
svg.desc: Selected data slots before padding, the A values assigned by the offset bases, and their actual LDS slots after padding. Slot 0 holds A[0,0], slot 1 A[0,1], slot 63 A[0,63], slot 64 A[16,0], slot 65 A[16,1], and slot 511 A[112,63]. These positions do not shift. Sixteen empty LDS slots, 512 through 527, precede data slot 512, which holds A[1,0] at actual LDS slot 528. Data slot 513 holds A[1,1] at actual slot 529.
svg.text: Choose the value, then add the padding
Selected slots from our A tile. Each slot holds one element.
Read across: q=512 → A[1,0] → LDS slot 528
All offsets count elements. An FP16 element uses 2 bytes.
